product.name: Equity & Debt Financing
product.description: Provides advice and solutions to optimize a company's capital structure through equity and debt financing, fundraising, bank financing, and financial restructuring.

product.name: Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A)
product.description: Offers advisory services for buying, selling, and restructuring companies, including deal execution, negotiation, and strategic alliance formation.

product.name: Works Council Advisory Services
product.description: Delivers financial advisory support to works councils on corporate transactions and strategic decisions affecting employees.
